column2: The war bands we sent over the border of [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] have come home for good. We cannot send them out again for now.
We shall ride east another day.
Our raiders are back from [offmap_cathay.GetFullName], dusty and laughing, their saddlebags heavy with copper cash, bolts of silk and the rice of the border villages they burned.
Bring the spoils to me!

On their way home our raiders fell upon a caravan on the road to Wei-Jin, a long line of carts loaded with silk, porcelain and jade. The guards fled at the first arrow. [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] smiles on the bold!
Fantastic! Bring it all to me!
Our raiders have outdone themselves. Near the border they caught a mandarin of the Jade Court travelling in disguise, and his house paid a fortune in gold, silk and porcelain to see him home again.
The treasures of [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] shall all be mine!

Our raiders never reached the villages. The terracotta sentinels and the crossbows of a border fort cut them to pieces in a mountain pass. A single survivor came home, and he does nothing but tell the tale of their defeat.
Curse it! This must be the work of [Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName]...

Our raiders came home by way of a mandarin's country house. Besides gold and silk they brought me a more personal prize: [cathayraid_captive.GetFullName], who is probably the [cathayraid_captive.GetSonDaughter] of the house.
A stunning beauty!
A fine hostage!
I shall make [cathayraid_captive.GetHerHim] my concubine.

This time our raiders broke into the workshop of a famous Cathayan siege engineer, where gunpowder rockets and great crossbows are made for the Dragon's armies. The master escaped, but they dragged one of his apprentices west: [cathayraid_engineer.GetFullName] will now serve me.
A siege engineer of my own? Excellent!
Make him a commander at once.
Dismiss a commander if needed to make room for the siege engineer.

Our raiders looted a shrine of the Celestial Dragons in a border town. Most of what they brought back is gold and incense, but the priests had hidden one piece in the temple vault: a true treasure of Grand Cathay.
A treasure of Cathay? Bring it to me!
You gain a treasure of Cathay. Such a prize comes only once in a lifetime.
Our raiders have brought back a pair of... bears? The black and white beasts are not fierce at all, and spend most of their time chewing bamboo and tumbling about. They will make grand pets!
Prepare an enclosure!

[cathayraid_viceroy.GetTitledName], Jade Viceroy of the West, writes to the marauding [Root.GetTitledName].\n\nThe Celestial Dragon Emperor has seen your bandits on his roads and in his villages. Heaven is patient, but it does not forget. Call back your dogs, or the armies of [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] will come to call them back for you.
I am not afraid of empty threats!
Despite every effort to make them breed, our pandas have died without young. Truly a sorrowful day...
Oh well.
Not my cuddly friends! How could you leave me?

The §Y[Root.Offmap.GetFullName]§! is overburdened with riches. Why beg the Emperor for grace when we can just take what we want?\n\nWhile we raid, all §YPay Tribute§! and §YAsk for Boon§! interactions are §Rdisabled§!, and stay so for five years after the raids end. We lose grace every month and part of our levies is away, but our raiders bring home loot every year. Only lords near the roads east can reach Cathay.
